name: The Duke's Son Claims He Won't Love Me Yet Showers Me With Adoration
original_name: 「きみを愛する気はない」と言った次期公爵様がなぜか溺愛してきます
overview: Elsa, the daughter of a fallen aristocrat, receives news. It was a marriage proposal from Julius, a very elite nobleman. Elsa wondered why such a distinguished man would propose to her. But after the wedding, Julius, who had been kind and gentle up to that point, changed completely. In a cold voice, he tells her, "I have no intention of loving you."
